summary.text: Alan Blaylock is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 93 in the November 3, 2026 general election and in the special election for the same seat held that day.
A Fort Worth City Council member from 2022 to 2026, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities are lower property taxes, reducing crime and supporting education.

paragraphs.text: Alan Blaylock was born in Fort Worth, Texas.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father and businessman.
Blaylock won a May 7, 2022 special general election for Fort Worth City Council District 4, and was re-elected in District 10 in 2023 and 2025.
He also served on the Tarrant County Appraisal District from January 12, 2024 to December 30, 2025.
Blaylock advanced from the Republican primary for District 93 on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Ericka Lomick in both the regular and special general elections.
In the Ballotpedia survey, Blaylock said his key messages were lower property taxes, stopping crime and empowering parents in education.
He listed endorsements from Governor Greg Abbott, Fort Worth Mayor Mattie Parker, the Fort Worth Police Officers Association and others.
